brms population-level term with the 'b_' prefix removed, for example 'Intercept' or 'z_recoded_grammaticality:z_recoded_session'. The recoded predictors are sum-coded contrasts standardised within the modelled cell: grammaticality Grammatical = +0.5 and Ungrammatical = -0.5; mini-language Mini-Norwegian = +0.5 and Mini-English = -0.5; session 0, 1, 2, 3 for Sessions 2, 3, 4, 6. Fits of the superseded cluster-row model (before 17 September 2026) also carried hemisphere and caudality terms, coded likewise; the trial-level models have none. z_baseline_predictor is the trial's own standardised pre-stimulus mean over the macroregion's clusters, z_multilingual_language_diversity the standardised LHQ3 covariate, and z_retention is +0.5 at the last sampled session and -0.5 elsewhere. Frozen copy of _pooled_posterior_summaries.csv as committed at 933279c (19 October 2026), from the Part A fits on the judgement trials of the legacy (200, 4000) ms reaction-time screen, with the screened Stroop index, kept for the sensitivity analysis of that screen and as the like-for-like reference of the Stroop comparison (ISSUES.md G06-03; supplement S9); no stage writes it. brms population-level term with the 'b_' prefix removed. Part A: z_session_time is the z-scored 0 to 3 growth-curve code of Sessions 2, 3, 4 and 6; z_<predictor> are the baseline predictors z-scored across participants; grammatical_property enters as treatment dummies against the reference level 'differential_object_marking'. Part B: session_prepost is -0.5 (pre) or +0.5 (post) and measure enters as dummies against the reference level 'digit_span'. One row per parameter per model.
Posterior median: on the logit scale for the Bernoulli Part A models, in SD units of the within-measure z-scored index for the Gaussian Part B models.

Probability of direction: the larger of the posterior mass above zero and below zero.

Where the fit-time fields (fitted_utc and the four version fields) come from. 'sampled' means the run that wrote the record sampled the fit, 'reloaded' that brms reloaded the cached fit unchanged and the fields were carried over from the sampling run's record, and 'recovered' that a reloaded fit had no earlier record, so the versions come from the stamp brms stores in the fit, fitted_utc from the cache file's modification time (an upper bound) and r_version is NA.
